let vs : ι → M := fun i => classical.choice (h i)
let v : M := classical.choice (⟨vs, λ i, (f i) (vs i) ≠ 0⟩.exists)
refine ⟨v, _⟩
intro i
have h_i : ∃ x, (f i) x ≠ 0 := h i
let x_i := classical.choice h_i
have hx_i : (f i) x_i ≠ 0 := classical.choice_spec h_i
obtain ⟨x, h_x⟩ := classical.choice (λ x, ∀ i, (f i) x ≠ 0)
exact h_x
